description: This PHP script is part of the vtiger CRM project and is responsible for renaming database tables and their columns by adding a specific prefix ('vtiger_'). It includes functions for retrieving table names, updating column names, and maintaining a migration log.

methods.name: get_tables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of database table names.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query on the database.

methods.name: fetch_row
methods.description: Fetches a row from the query result set.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes a given SQL command, used for renaming tables and updating columns.
